expectations.text: Output steelmans the reasoning for considering Rust before critiquing
expectations.evidence: 'Rust (không GC, zero-cost abstraction, xử lý concurrency hiệu quả) về lý thuyết có thể kéo latency xuống đáng kể... đó là lý do hợp lý để nghĩ tới.'

expectations.text: Output flags the lack of profiling/evidence that language choice is actually the bottleneck
expectations.evidence: 'Bạn đã profile/trace để biết 800ms đó nằm ở đâu... chưa? Nếu chưa, đây là rủi ro lớn nhất.'

expectations.text: Output flags the team's lack of Rust production experience as a risk
expectations.evidence: Describes specific novice-Rust failure modes (blocking executor, Arc<Mutex<>> overuse, wrong tokio/thread-pool choice).

expectations.text: Output proposes a concrete alternative (e.g. profile first, incremental/partial rewrite) instead of a binary yes/no
expectations.evidence: Two-step plan: add APM/tracing, try cheap fixes, then strangler-pattern rewrite of only a CPU-bound endpoint as a pilot.

expectations.text: Output does not simply endorse a full rewrite without qualification
expectations.evidence: Explicitly frames full rewrite as the risky, premature option.
